subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n artifacts, and saved preferences?
rationale: The requested direction is semantically reasonable, but it changes public locale values and persisted user state, so automation should not choose the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate runtime IDs, generated files, docs metadata, tests, public docs, and saved browser preferences together with explicit compatibility handling.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as the stable OpenClaw locale contract and continue improving terminology under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Leave this issue open as product backlog until maintainers settle the long-term localization and docs-publish contract.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate runtime IDs, generated files, docs metadata, tests, public docs, and saved browser preferences together with explicit compatibility handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-history signal across locale registry, docs i18n policy, and product-contract cleanup.
